title: Vented and flared gas
headline: 0.0 MMcfd is the EIA 2024 state total for vented and flared gas (0 MMcf that year). Lease circles are still empty. The public well service did not respond on this run, so lease volumes were not updated.
method: Pipelines are the EIA centerline compilation from January 2020, clipped to this state. Transmission lines are the public 230 kV-and-above subset in the project database. A tie-in point is a stored 230 kV-or-higher line midpoint within 3 miles of a gas-pipeline midpoint. Points of interconnection are substations and taps of 69 kV and above, from the same public substation republish and transmission-line archive used for the Texas Permian view. The EIA state total is process VGV. The public well service did not respond on this run, so lease volumes were not updated.
